description: Capture a V8 heap memory snapshot, parse top object constructors & Detached DOM nodes, and detect memory leaks via baseline/diff comparison. Automatically triggers V8 Garbage Collection before snapshot unless collectGarbage: false.

action.description: Memory action: 'baseline' (record GC'd baseline for tab), 'diff' / 'check_leak' (compare current GC'd heap against tab baseline to pinpoint growing constructors, detached DOM nodes, and listener leaks), 'snapshot' (default, parse heap & compare if baseline exists), or 'gc' (trigger V8 GC only)

collectGarbage.description: Trigger V8 Garbage Collection before capturing snapshot (default: true)

compareWithBaseline.description: Compare this snapshot against the stored per-tab baseline to detect memory leaks

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

filePath.description: Raw .heapsnapshot output for isolated context tabs; required there. Native tabs keep their constructor/baseline summaries.

forceGC.description: Alias for collectGarbage: trigger V8 Garbage Collection before snapshot (default: true)

maxConstructors.description: Maximum number of top object constructors to return (default: 20)

recordBaseline.description: Explicitly save this snapshot as the new per-tab memory baseline
